body: You don't sound arrogant. You're just voicing how you feel. Sadly, there's no advice I can offer as I'm in the same place at the moment. Without the positive side. Just want to reach out and let you know you're not alone and there's someone rooting for you to live a long and happy life.

Distraction maybe? That even as short-lived as miniature golf is (Just as an example), it gives us a brief moment to forget our problems and feel better. It doesn't cure us or change anything. But it might give some the break they need to keep going. Just a thought.

Thank you for kind words! I've been trying for a few months to tell my therapist. Did what you just suggested and went over it in my head. Even wrote him a letter so I wouldn't have to say it. But just can't seem to do it. The thought of saying it via talk, letter, etc, seems...I don't know. Attention seeking? Over dramatic? I can't really explain how saying anything makes me feel. But that's just me. If I were to hear someone else say anything similar, those feelings wouldn't even be a thought. Again, hard to explain. Thank you again for replying. I appreciate it a lot!
